entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Diablo 3D candidate item study based strictly on private attached ICURS 157, item.design.unique.arkaine-s-valor. The unique name/powers do not authorize redesign. Compact armor with two bright silver-gray thick curled/wing-like raised shoulder/collar plates surrounding an empty dark ochre oval neck opening; narrow ochre-gold structural bands on chest/neck, a deep red padded horizontal mid-torso panel, large rounded convex ochre-gold belly/hip plate tapering to lower point, two separate bulky silver-gray side/forearm-like plates at lower sides, and two wide dull ochre diagonal lower flaps crossing in an X. Preserve actual silver/red/ochre composition, voids and short silhouette. Rear hidden construction inferred. No helmet, body, hands, legs or invented heroic crest.
Produce EXACTLY FIVE separate complete newly painted realistic HD depictions: four large views FRONT (native source face), SIDE (90-degree true profile), BACK (opposite physical rear surface), 3-4 (45 degrees showing front AND side, distinct from SIDE), then fifth smaller matching inventory ICON below/right. Never merge 3-4/ICON. Every view includes the same complete set and identical color blocks, curves, lengths and ornament/fastener placements. BACK must show a minimal plausible rear of same object, NOT copy the front chest fastener/ornament onto the back unless actually required by physical construction. Keep all source pieces in frame, separated. Charcoal gray background, neutral soft studio light, restrained realistic candidate metal/textile/leather, no painted floor shadow. No character, body, head, mannequin, hands, skin, support stand, scenery, weapons, spell lettering, glow or source sprite inset. ICON is NEW HD art, never native pixels. Rear, thickness, attachment, red detail material and hardware construction are cautious inferences. No class redesign, rig or runtime deliverable; unapproved art study.

reference.notes: Referência nativa 6x inspecionada antes da chamada. Fonte privada usada apenas para silhueta/cores; pixels não incorporados.

inferredAreas: Verso, espessura, construção e materiais propostos a partir de uma vista; não constituem geometria histórica recuperada.

coherenceReview.observed: Cinco representações; ombros prateados curvos, torso vermelho, barriga ocre, placas laterais e faixas inferiores cruzadas preservados.
pendingIssues: Interpretação dos elementos laterais como placas de quadril e das faixas como tassets em X é inferida; confirmar sem assumir membros/armas.
Quilting/rebites, fecho/verso e espessura não vêm resolvidos da fonte; revisar folga rígida/flexível e fitting por classe.

entries.notes: Candidato sem aprovação. Thumbnail HD de estudo não é ícone runtime. Master/material, chão, rig/encaixe e legibilidade na grade lógica de 28px continuam pendentes.
